title: Croatian-Style Prawn Skewers
description: Tender prawns marinated in a zesty Croatian-inspired blend of herbs and spices, grilled to perfection on skewers.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, red onion, parsley, dill, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the prawns to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Thread the marinated prawns onto the skewers, leaving space between each prawn.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the prawns are pink and cooked through.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley and lemon wedges if desired.
Let the skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Serve with a side of hearty, crusty bread or a simple green salad.
Enjoy your delicious Croatian-style prawn skewers!
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
Reheat the skewers in the oven or on the stovetop before serving.
